method:
Measure all NOIZE JAMS DAC reconnects using the existing fixed oracle map.

Native PCM, gain, timing map and the 1 ms envelope resolution are retained.
The wider hardware window adds the previously measured onset discrepancy on
both sides; it is descriptive sensitivity analysis, not a confidence bound.
limits: Hardware filtering, LFSR phase and register timing remain unknown; no local fit or EQ. floor(on*rate) includes the PCM bin straddling the register write; timestamp-only slicing can place this reconnect sample just before the nominal boundary.
